40020911.author: पदार्थः
40020911.content: सः he, तु indeed, तत्र there, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), सह with, सैन्येन his army, वीर्यवान् the powerful one, अस्तम् setting, प्राप्ते having reached, दिनकरे the sun, निवासम् residence, समरोचयत् chose.

40020911.author: Translation
40020911.content: There, the powerful Ravana, along with his army, chose to reside as the sun was setting.

40020912.author: पदार्थः
40020912.content: उदिते having risen, विमले pure, चन्द्रे the moon, तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि having splendor equal to a mountain, प्रसुप्तं sleeping, सुमहत्सैन्यं a very large army, नानाप्रहरणायुधम् with various weapons and arms.

40020912.author: Translation
40020912.content: As the pure moon, shining with the brilliance of a mountain, rose, a vast army equipped with diverse weapons lay asleep.

40020913.author: पदार्थः
40020913.content: रावणस्तु but Ravana, महावीर्यो very powerful, निषण्णः seated, शैलमूर्धनि on the mountain peak, सः he, ददर्श saw, गुणांस्तत्र the beauties there, चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् adorned by moonlit trees.

40020913.author: Translation
40020913.content: But the mighty Ravana, seated on the mountain peak, beheld the beautiful features of that place, enhanced by trees illuminated by the moonlight.

40020914.author: पदार्थः
40020914.content: कर्णिकारवनैः by forests of Karnikara trees, दीप्तैः shining, कदम्बगहनैः by dense Kadamba groves, तथा and also, पद्मिनीभिश्च and by lotus ponds, फुल्लाभिः full-blown, मन्दाकिन्या of the Mandakini river, जलैरपि and by waters.

40020914.author: Translation
40020914.content: He saw the beauty created by radiant Karnikara forests, dense Kadamba groves, blooming lotus ponds, and the waters of the Mandakini river.

40020915.author: पदार्थः
40020915.content: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमन्दारतरुभिः by trees like Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, and Mandara, तथा and also, चूतपाटललोध्रैश्च and by Mango, Patala, and Lodhra trees, प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः by Priyangu, Arjuna, and Ketaka trees, तगरैः by Tagara trees, नारिकैलैश्च and by Narikela (coconut) trees, प्रियालपनसैः by Priyala and Panasa (jackfruit) trees, तथा and also.

40020915.author: Translation
40020915.content: The scene was further adorned by trees such as Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, Mandara, Mango, Patala, Lodhra, Priyangu, Arjuna, Ketaka, Tagara, Narikela, Priyala, and Panasa.

40020916.author: पदार्थः
40020916.content: आरग्वधैः by Aragvadha trees, तमालैश्च and by Tamala trees, प्रियालवकुलैरपि and also by Priyala and Bakula trees, एतैः by these, अन्यैश्च and by other, तरुभिः trees, उद्भासितवनान्तरे in the forest region made radiant, किन्नरा Kinnaras, मदनेनार्ता afflicted by love, रक्ता passionate, मधुरकण्ठिनः having sweet voices.

40020916.author: Translation
40020916.content: In that forest region, illuminated by these and other trees like Aragvadha, Tamala, Priyala, and Bakula, Kinnaras, tormented by love, sang passionately with their sweet voices.

40020917.author: पदार्थः
40020917.content: समं equally, सम्प्रजगुः they sang well, यत्र where, मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् increasing the satisfaction of the mind.

40020917.author: Translation
40020917.content: Where they sang together in unison, their songs greatly increased the satisfaction of the mind.

40020918.author: पदार्थः
40020918.content: भिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे in the brightly lit forest interior, विद्याधराः Vidyadharas, मदक्षीबाः intoxicated, मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः with eyes red from intoxication, योषिद्भिः with women, सह together, सङ्क्रान्ताः having assembled, चिक्रीडुः they played, जहृषुः they rejoiced, च and, वै indeed.

40020918.author: Translation
40020918.content: In the brightly lit forest interior, the Vidyadharas, intoxicated and with eyes red from drink, assembled with their women and indeed played and rejoiced.

40020919.author: पदार्थः
40020919.content: घण्टानाम् of bells, इव like, सन्नादः a sound, शुश्रुवे was heard, मधुरस्वरः a sweet sound, अप्सरोगणसङ्घानाम् of groups of Apsaras, गायताम् singing, धनदालये in the abode of Kubera.

40020919.author: Translation
40020919.content: In Kubera's abode, a sweet sound was heard, like the ringing of bells, from the singing groups of Apsaras.

40020920.author: पदार्थः
40020920.content: पुष्पवर्षाणि showers of flowers, मुञ्चन्तः releasing, नगाः trees, पवनताडिताः struck by the wind, शैलम् the mountain, तम् that, वासयन्तीव as if perfuming, मधुमाधवगन्धिनः fragrant with the scent of spring flowers.

40020920.author: Translation
40020920.content: The trees, swayed by the wind, released showers of flowers, as if perfuming that mountain with the fragrance of spring blossoms.

40020921.author: पदार्थः
40020921.content: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तम् mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, गन्धम् fragrance, आदाय taking, पुष्कलम् abundant, प्रववौ blew, वर्धयन् increasing, कामम् desire, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुखः pleasant, अनिलः wind.

40020921.author: Translation
40020921.content: A pleasant wind blew, carrying the abundant fragrance mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, thereby increasing Ravana's desire.

40020922.author: पदार्थः
40020922.content: गेयात् from singing, पुष्पसमृद्ध्या by the abundance of flowers, च and, शैत्यात् from the coolness, वायोः of the wind, गिरेः of the mountain, गुणात् from the quality, प्रवृत्तायाम् having begun, रजन्याम् in the night, च and, चन्द्रस्य of the moon, उदयनेन by the rising, च and.

40020922.author: Translation
40020922.content: The night had set in, enhanced by the melodious music, the profusion of flowers, the cool mountain breeze, and the rising of the moon.

40020923.author: पदार्थः
40020923.content: रावणस्तु but Ravana, महावीर्यः of great valor, कामस्य of desire, वशम् under the sway, आगतः having come, विनिःश्वस्य sighing deeply, विनिःश्वस्य sighing deeply, शशिनम् at the moon, समवैक्षत looked intently.

40020923.author: Translation
40020923.content: Ravana, despite his great might, had fallen under the sway of desire and repeatedly sighed deeply as he gazed at the moon.

40020924.author: पदार्थः
40020924.content: एतस्मिन् at this, अन्तरे moment, तत्र there, दिव्याभरणभूषिता adorned with divine ornaments, सर्वाप्सरोवरा the best of all Apsaras, रम्भा Rambha, दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता adorned with divine flowers.

40020924.author: Translation
40020924.content: At that very moment, Rambha, the foremost of all Apsaras, appeared there, adorned with divine ornaments and divine flowers.

40020925.author: पदार्थः
40020925.content: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी whose limbs were smeared with divine sandalwood paste, मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा whose hair was adorned with Mandara flowers, दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा who had begun a divine celebration, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना whose face resembled the full moon.

40020925.author: Translation
40020925.content: Her body was smeared with divine sandalwood, her hair adorned with Mandara flowers, she had initiated a divine celebration, and her face shone like the full moon.

40020926.author: पदार्थः
40020926.content: चक्षुर्मनोहरम् charming to the eyes and mind, पीनम् plump, मेखलादामभूषितम् adorned with a girdle of bells, समुद्वहन्ती bearing, जघनम् hips, रतिप्राभृतम् a gift for love, उत्तमम् excellent.

40020926.author: Translation
40020926.content: She bore her hips, which were plump, charming to the eyes and mind, adorned with a girdle of bells, and an excellent offering for love.

40020927.author: पदार्थः
40020927.content: कृतैः made, विशेषकैः with special marks/decorations, आर्द्रैः fresh, षडर्तु of six seasons, कुसुम flowers, उद्भवैः produced from

40020927.author: Translation
40020927.content: She was adorned with fresh, special marks made from flowers of all six seasons.

40020928.author: पदार्थः
40020928.content: बभाव she appeared, अन्यतमेव as if another (form), श्री of beauty, कान्ति of splendor, द्युति of radiance, मति of intelligence, ह्रियाम् of modesty, नीलं blue, सतोय with water, मेघाभं cloud-like, वस्त्रं garment, समवकुण्ठिता covered

40020928.author: Translation
40020928.content: She appeared as if another embodiment of beauty, splendor, radiance, intelligence, and modesty, covered in a blue garment resembling a water-laden cloud.

40020929.author: पदार्थः
40020929.content: यस्याः whose, वक्त्रं face, शशिनिभं moon-like, भ्रुवौ eyebrows, चापनिभे bow-like, शुभे beautiful, ऊरू thighs, करिकराकारौ elephant's trunk-like, करौ hands, पल्लवकोमलौ tender like sprouts, सैन्यमध्येन through the midst of the army, गच्छन्ती going, रावणेन by Ravana, उपवीक्षिता was seen

40020929.author: Translation
40020929.content: Her face was like the moon, her beautiful eyebrows like bows, her thighs like elephant trunks, and her hands soft as new leaves; as she walked through the army, she was observed by Ravana.

40020930.author: पदार्थः
40020930.content: तां her, समुत्थाय having risen, गच्छन्तीं going, कामबाणवशं under the sway of Cupid's arrows, गतः fallen, करे by the hand, गृहीत्वा having seized, लज्जन्तीं blushing, स्मयमानः smiling, अभ्यभाषत he spoke to

40020930.author: Translation
40020930.content: Having risen, Ravana, fallen under the sway of Cupid's arrows, seized her hand as she was going, and smiling, spoke to the blushing woman.

40020931.author: पदार्थः
40020931.content: क्व where, गच्छसि you go, वरारोहे O lady with beautiful hips, कां what, सिद्धिं accomplishment, भजसे you seek, स्वयम् yourself, कस्य whose, अभ्युदयकालः time of prosperity, अयं this, यः who, त्वां you, समुपभोक्ष्यते will enjoy

40020931.author: Translation
40020931.content: "Where do you go, O lady of beautiful hips, what accomplishment do you seek for yourself, and whose time of prosperity is this, that he will enjoy you?"

40020932.author: पदार्थः
40020932.content: त्वदाननरसस्य of the essence of your face, अद्य today, पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः fragrant like lotus and water-lily, सुधामृतरसस्य of the essence of divine nectar, इव like, कः who, अद्य today, तृप्तिं satisfaction, गमिष्यति will attain.

40020932.author: Translation
40020932.content: Who today will ever be satisfied with the essence of your face, fragrant like lotuses and water-lilies, which is like the essence of divine nectar?

40020933.author: पदार्थः
40020933.content: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ resembling golden pitchers, पीनौ plump, शुभौ beautiful, भीरु O timid one, निरन्तरौ close-set, कस्य whose, उरस्थलसंस्पर्शं contact with the chest, दास्यतः will give, ते your, कुचाविमौ these two breasts.

40020933.author: Translation
40020933.content: O timid one, whose chest will these two plump, beautiful, close-set breasts of yours, resembling golden pitchers, touch?

40020934.author: पदार्थः
40020934.content: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं resembling a golden disc, स्वर्णदामचितं adorned with golden chains, पृथु broad, अध्यारोहति will ascend, कः who, ते your, अद्य today, जघनं hips, स्वर्गरूपिणम् having the form of heaven.

40020934.author: Translation
40020934.content: Who today will ascend your broad hips, which resemble a golden disc, are adorned with golden chains, and are like heaven itself?

40020935.author: पदार्थः
40020935.content: मद्विशिष्टः superior to me, पुमान् man, कः who, अद्य today, शक्रः Indra, विष्णुः Vishnu, अथ or, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, माम् me, अतीत्य surpassing, हि indeed, यं whom, च and, त्वं you, यासि go, भीरु O timid one, न not, शोभनम् proper.

40020935.author: Translation
40020935.content: Who is that man superior to me today, be it Indra, Vishnu, or the Ashvins, whom you, O timid one, would go to, leaving me behind, for that would not be proper?

40020936.author: पदार्थः
40020936.content: विश्रम rest, त्वं you, पृथुश्रोणि O broad-hipped one, शिलातलम् rock surface, इदं this, शुभम् beautiful.

40020936.author: Translation
40020936.content: O broad-hipped one, you should rest on this beautiful rock surface.

40020937.author: पदार्थः
40020937.content: त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यः who, प्रभुः lord, च and, एव indeed, मदन्यः other than me, न not, एव indeed, विद्यते exists.

40020937.author: Translation
40020937.content: There is no lord in the three worlds other than me.

40020938.author: पदार्थः
40020938.content: तत् therefore, एवम् thus, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रह्वः bowed down, याचते begs, त्वाम् you, दशाननः the ten-headed one (Ravana), भर्तुः of the husband, भर्ता the husband (lord), विधाता the creator, च and, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, भजस्व worship, माम् me.

40020938.author: Translation
40020938.content: Therefore, the ten-headed Ravana, bowing down with folded hands, begs you, "Worship me, for I am the lord of lords and the creator of the three worlds."

40020939.author: पदार्थः
40020939.content: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, अब्रवीत् said, रम्भा Rambha, वेपमाना trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रसीद be pleased (have mercy), न not, अर्हसे you ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such a thing, त्वम् you, हि indeed, मे my, गुरुः elder/revered one.

40020939.author: Translation
40020939.content: Thus addressed, Rambha, trembling and with folded hands, replied, "Please have mercy; you should not speak such words, for you are indeed like an elder to me."

40020940.author: पदार्थः
40020940.content: अन्येभ्यः from others, हि indeed, त्वया by you, रक्ष्या to be protected, प्राप्नुयाम् I might obtain, धर्षणम् molestation/violation, यदि if, तत् therefore, धर्मतः by dharma/righteously, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, ते your, अहम् I, तत्त्वम् the truth, एव indeed, ब्रवीमि I tell, ते to you.

40020940.author: Translation
40020940.content: You are indeed the one who should protect me from molestation by others, and by dharma, I am your daughter-in-law; I tell you this truth.

40020941.author: पदार्थः
40020941.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः the ten-necked one (Ravana), चरणाधोमुखीम् with face turned downwards towards the feet, स्थिताम् standing, रोमहर्षम् goosebumps/horripilation, अनुप्राप्ताम् having obtained, दृष्टमात्रेण by merely seeing, ताम् her, तदा then.

40020941.author: Translation
40020941.content: Then Ravana spoke to her, who was standing with her face turned downwards towards his feet, having gotten goosebumps merely upon seeing him.

40020942.author: पदार्थः
40020942.content: सुतस्य of the son, यदि if, मे my, भार्या wife, ततस् then, त्वं you, हि indeed, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, भवेः would be, बाढम् "Indeed", इति एव thus, सा she, रम्भा Rambha, प्राह said, रावणम् to Ravana, उत्तरम् in reply.

40020942.author: Translation
40020942.content: Rambha replied to Ravana, saying, "If I were the wife of your son, then you would indeed be my father-in-law."

40020943.author: पदार्थः
40020943.content: धर्मतस् by religious law, ते your, सुतस्य of the son, अहम् I, भार्या wife, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas, पुत्रः son, प्रियतरः dearer, प्राणैः than life, भ्रातुः of the brother, वैश्रवणस्य of Vaishravana (Kubera), ते your, विख्यातस् renowned, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, नलकूबरः Nalakubara, इति अयम् thus this one.

40020943.author: Translation
40020943.content: O best of Rakshasas, I am rightfully the wife of your son, Nalakubara, who is dearer to your brother Vaishravana (Kubera) than life itself and is renowned in all three worlds.

40020944.author: पदार्थः
40020944.content: धर्मतस् by righteousness, यः who, भवेत् would be, विप्रः a Brahmin, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, वीर्यतस् by valor, भवेत् would be, क्रोधात् from anger, यः च and who, भवेत् would be, अग्निः fire, क्षान्त्या by patience, च and, वसुधासमः equal to the earth.

40020944.author: Translation
40020944.content: He (Nalakubara) is like a Brahmin by righteousness, a Kshatriya by valor, fire by his anger, and equal to the earth in patience.

40020945.author: पदार्थः
40020945.content: तस्य of him, अस्मि I am, कृतसङ्केता one who has made a promise, लोकपालसुतस्य of the son of a Lokapala, वै indeed, तम् him, उद्दिश्य intending, तु but, मे my, सर्वम् all, विभूषणम् ornaments, इदम् this, कृतम् made.

40020945.author: Translation
40020945.content: I am indeed promised to him, the son of a Lokapala, and all these ornaments I wear are for his sake.

40020946.author: पदार्थः
40020946.content: तथा thus, तस्य of him, हि indeed, न not, अन्यस्य of another, भावः feeling, माम् me, प्रति towards, तिष्ठति exists.

40020946.author: Translation
40020946.content: Thus, my affection is indeed for him alone, and not for anyone else.

40020947.author: पदार्थः
40020947.content: तेन by that, सत्येन truth, माम् me, राजन् O king, मोक्तुम् to release, अर्हसि you ought, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies

40020947.author: Translation
40020947.content: O King, destroyer of enemies, by that truth, you ought to release me.

40020948.author: पदार्थः
40020948.content: सः he, हि indeed, तिष्ठति waits, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, माम् me, प्रतीक्ष्य waiting for, समुत्सुकः very eager, तत्र there, विघ्नम् an obstacle, सुतस्य for the son, इह here, कर्तुम् to create, न not, अर्हसि you ought, मुञ्च release, माम् me

40020948.author: Translation
40020948.content: Indeed, that righteous one waits for me, very eager; you ought not to create an obstacle for your son in this matter, so release me.

40020949.author: पदार्थः
40020949.content: सद्भिः by the good people, आचरितम् practiced, मार्गम् path, गच्छ follow, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas, माननीयः worthy of respect, मम to me, त्वम् you, हि indeed, पालनीया to be protected, तथा similarly, अस्मि I am, ते by you

40020949.author: Translation
40020949.content: O best of Rakshasas, follow the path practiced by the good; you are indeed worthy of respect to me, and I am similarly to be protected by you.

40020950.author: पदार्थः
40020950.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रत्युवाच replied, विनीतवत् as if humbly, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, अस्मि I am, यत् that which, अवोचः you said, त्वम् you, एकपत्नीषु among those with one husband, अयम् this, क्रमः custom, देवलोकस्थितिः the custom of the divine world, इयम् this, सुराणाम् of the gods, शाश्वती eternal, मता considered

40020950.author: Translation
40020950.content: Thus addressed, Dashagriva replied as if humbly, saying that what she spoke about being a daughter-in-law and the custom of having one husband applies only to women with a single spouse, and that this custom of the divine world for gods is considered eternal.

40020951.author: पदार्थः
40020951.content: पतिः husband, अप्सरसाम् of Apsaras, न not, अस्ति exists, न nor, च and, एकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः the custom of having one wife

40020951.author: Translation
40020951.content: There is no single husband for Apsaras, nor is there a custom of having only one wife.

40020952.author: पदार्थः
40020952.content: अस्मि I am, यत् what, अवोचः you said, त्वम् you, एकपत्नीषु among chaste wives, अयम् this, क्रमः rule, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, सः he, ताम् her, रक्षः the demon, निवेश्य having placed, च and, शिलातले on a rock surface, कामभोगाभिसंसक्तः deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, मैथुनाय for sexual union, उपचक्रमे began.

40020952.author: Translation
40020952.content: Having said, "I am what you said, this is the rule among chaste wives," the demon Ravana, deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, placed her on a rock surface and proceeded to engage in sexual union.

40020953.author: पदार्थः
40020953.content: सा she, विमुक्ता released, ततः then, रम्भा Rambha, भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा with fallen garlands and ornaments, गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता churned by the sport of a lordly elephant, नदी a river, इव like, आकुलताम् agitation, गता attained.

40020953.author: Translation
40020953.content: Rambha, thus released, with her garlands and ornaments fallen, became agitated like a river churned by the sport of a lordly elephant.

40020954.author: पदार्थः
40020954.content: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता with disheveled and scattered hair, करवेपितपल्लवा with trembling hands (like trembling sprouts), पवनेन by the wind, अवधूता shaken, इव like, लता a creeper, कुसुमशालिनी adorned with flowers.

40020954.author: Translation
40020954.content: Her hair was disheveled and scattered, and her hands trembled like sprouts, resembling a flower-laden creeper shaken by the wind.

40020955.author: पदार्थः
40020955.content: सा she, वेपमाना trembling, लज्जन्ती feeling ashamed, भीता frightened, करकृताञ्जलिः with hands joined in supplication, नलकूबरम् Nalakubara, आसाद्य having approached, पादयोः at the feet, निपपात fell down, ह indeed.

40020955.author: Translation
40020955.content: Trembling, ashamed, and frightened, she approached Nalakubara with folded hands and fell at his feet.

40020956.author: पदार्थः
40020956.content: तत् that, अवस्थाम् state, च and, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महात्मा the great-souled, नलकूबरः Nalakubara, अब्रवीत् said, किम् what, इदम् this, भद्रे O gentle one, पादयोः at the feet, पतिता fallen, असि you are, मे my.

40020956.author: Translation
40020956.content: Seeing her in that state, the great-souled Nalakubara asked, "O gentle one, what is this, that you have fallen at my feet?"

40020957.author: पदार्थः
40020957.content: सा she, वै indeed, निःश्वसमाना sighing deeply, तु and, वेपमाना trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, तस्मै to him, सर्वं all, यथातत्त्वम् as it truly happened, आख्यातुम् to narrate, उपचक्रमे began.

40020957.author: Translation
40020957.content: Trembling and sighing deeply, she, with folded hands, began to narrate everything to him exactly as it had happened.

40020958.author: पदार्थः
40020958.content: एष this, देव O god, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्राप्तः arrived, गन्तुम् to go, त्रिविष्टपम् to heaven, तेन by him, सैन्यसहायेन with the help of his army, निशा इयम् this night, परिणामिता was passed.

40020958.author: Translation
40020958.content: O god, this Dashagriva arrived here to go to heaven, and with the help of his army, he spent this night.

40020959.author: पदार्थः
40020959.content: आयन्ती while coming, तेन by him, दृष्टा seen, अस्मि I am, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies, गृहीता seized, तेन by him, पृष्टा asked, अस्मि I am, कस्य whose, त्वम् you, इति thus, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa.

40020959.author: Translation
40020959.content: O destroyer of enemies, I was seen by him while coming to your presence, and I was seized and asked by that Rakshasa, "Whose are you?"

40020960.author: पदार्थः
40020960.content: मया by me, तु but, सर्वं all, यत् सत्यम् which was true, तस्मै to him, सर्वं all, निवेदितम् was reported, काममोहाभिभूतात्मा whose mind was overcome by lust and delusion, न not, अश्रौषीत् heard, तत् that, वचः word, मम my.

40020960.author: Translation
40020960.content: But I reported everything truly to him, yet his mind, overcome by lust and delusion, did not listen to my words.

40020961.author: पदार्थः
40020961.content: याच्यमानः being implored, मया by me, देव O god, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, ते your, अहम् I, इति thus, प्रभो O lord, तत् सर्वम् all that, पृष्ठतः कृत्वा having put aside, बलात् by force, तेन by him, अस्मि I am, धर्षिता violated.

40020961.author: Translation
40020961.content: O god, O lord, despite being implored by me that I am your daughter-in-law, he disregarded all that and forcibly violated me.

40020962.author: पदार्थः
40020962.content: एवम् thus, त्वम् you, अपराधम् offense, मे my, क्षन्तुम् to forgive, अर्हसि ought, सुव्रत O one of good vows, न not, हि indeed, तुल्यम् equal, बलम् strength, सौम्य O gentle one, स्त्रियाः of a woman, च and, पुरुषस्य of a man, च and,

40020962.author: Translation
40020962.content: O virtuous and gentle one, you ought to forgive my offense, for indeed, the strength of a woman and a man is not equal.

40020963.author: पदार्थः
40020963.content: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, तदा then, वैश्रवणात्मजः the son of Vaishravana, धर्षणाम् outrage, ताम् that, पराम् extreme, श्रुत्वा having heard, ध्यानम् deep thought, सम्प्रविवेश entered completely, ह indeed,

40020963.author: Translation
40020963.content: Having heard this, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) became greatly enraged and, upon hearing of that extreme outrage, he entered into deep contemplation.

40020964.author: पदार्थः
40020964.content: तस्य his, तत् that, कर्म deed, विज्ञाय having understood, तदा then, वैश्रवणात्मजः the son of Vaishravana, मुहूर्तात् in a moment, क्रोधताम्राक्षः with eyes red from anger, तोयम् water, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand,

40020964.author: Translation
40020964.content: Having understood that deed of his, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) instantly, with eyes red from anger, took water in his hand.

40020965.author: पदार्थः
40020965.content: गृहीत्वा having taken, सलिलम् water, सर्वम् all, उपस्पृश्य having touched, यथाविधि according to the ritual, उत्ससर्ज he released, यथा as, शापम् a curse, राक्षसेन्द्राय to the king of Rakshasas, दारुणम् terrible,

40020965.author: Translation
40020965.content: Having taken the water and performed the ritual purification, he then uttered a terrible curse upon the king of Rakshasas (Ravana).

40020966.author: पदार्थः
40020966.content: अकामा unwilling, तेन by him, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, बलात् by force, भद्रे O auspicious one, प्रधर्षिता molested, तस्मात् therefore, सः he, युवतीम् a young woman, अन्याम् another, न not, अकामाम् unwilling, उपयास्यति will approach,

40020966.author: Translation
40020966.content: O auspicious one, because you were molested by him by force against your will, therefore he will not approach another young woman who is unwilling.

40020967.author: पदार्थः
40020967.content: यदा when, हि indeed, अकामां an unwilling, कामार्तः lust-struck, धर्षयिष्यति will violate, योषितम् a woman, मूर्धा head, तु but, सप्तधा into seven parts, तस्य his, शकलीभविता will be shattered, तदा then.

40020967.author: Translation
40020967.content: When a lust-struck man violates an unwilling woman, his head will indeed shatter into seven pieces.

40020968.author: पदार्थः
40020968.content: तस्मिन् upon that, उदाहृते having been uttered, शापे curse, ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे shining like a blazing fire, देवदुन्दुभयः divine drums, नेदुः resounded, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, च and, खात् from the sky, च्युता fell, पितामहमुखाः led by Brahma, च and, एव indeed, सर्वे all, देवाः gods, प्रहर्षिताः greatly delighted.

40020968.author: Translation
40020968.content: Upon the utterance of that curse, which shone like a blazing fire, divine drums resounded, a shower of flowers fell from the sky, and all the gods, led by Brahma, were greatly delighted.

40020969.author: पदार्थः
40020969.content: ज्ञात्वा having known, लोकगतिं the course of the world, सर्वां all, तस्य his, मृत्युं death, च and, रक्षसः of the demon, ऋषयः sages, पितरः ancestors, च and, एव indeed, प्रीतिम् joy, आपुः attained, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed.

40020969.author: Translation
40020969.content: Understanding the entire course of the world and the demon's impending death, the sages and ancestors indeed experienced unsurpassed joy.

40020970.author: पदार्थः
40020970.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु but, स he, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तं that, शापं curse, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, नारीषु among women, मैथुने in sexual intercourse, भावं inclination, न not, अकामासु unwilling, अभ्यरोचयत् he approved.

40020970.author: Translation
40020970.content: But having heard that terrifying, hair-raising curse, Dashagriva no longer desired sexual intimacy with unwilling women.

40020971.author: पदार्थः
40020971.content: तेन by that, नीताः taken, स्त्रियः women, प्रीतिम् joy, आपुः attained, सर्वाः all, पतिव्रताः chaste, नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं uttered by Nalakubara, शापं curse, श्रुत्वा having heard, मनःप्रियम् pleasing to the mind.

40020971.author: Translation
40020971.content: All the chaste women who had been abducted by him attained great joy upon hearing that delightful curse uttered by Nalakubara. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षड्वविंशः सर्गः ।। 26 ।। Thus ends the twenty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
